   270

   293	    def get_connection(self, url, proxies=None):

   296	        :class:`HTTPAdapter <requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter>`.

   302	        proxy = select_proxy(url, proxies)
   303	
   304	        if proxy:

   306	            proxy_url = parse_url(proxy)

   309	                                      " and could be missing the host.")
